cohort: GSE78220; explicit GEO patient id and pre-treatment biopsy only; exclude Pt16 OnTx
signatures: unchanged 15 modules x 2 branches; no outcome-selected genes, directions or thresholds
patient_policy: primary mean linear FPKM across baseline biopsies per patient before log; sensitivity exclude patients with multiple baseline biopsies
score: log2(FPKM+.001), gene z within baseline patient cohort ddof1, mean >=48 variable uniquely mapped genes; FPKM score not directly comparable to TCGA TPM
response: CR/PR vs PD/SD using explicit GEO response; no response imputation
statistic: two-sided Mann Whitney U exact if no ties, asymptotic with ties; signed AUC=P(score responder > score nonresponder)+0.5 ties, never flip direction
sensitivity: 9999 response-label permutations within previous MAPKi x study site x library strandedness strata; strata without mixed responses contribute no exchange
family: BH across all 15 CM x 2 branches x 2 biopsy policies x 2 tests within this cohort; cross-cohort correction pending
limitations: small previously used cohort, not untouched validation; retrospective response association not treatment-specific predictive effect; no untreated comparator; no survival analysis
